paper_reference.title: A Si BiCMOS Transimpedance Amplifier for 10-Gb/s SONET Receiver

Transimpedance Gain.description: Gain of the full TIA circuit (not measurable in this extracted sub-circuit)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Metric applies to the full TIA, not the extracted bias network.

Bandwidth.description: Operating bandwidth of the full TIA

sky130_expected.reasoning: Metric applies to the full TIA.

Power Consumption.description: Total power consumption of the TIA

sky130_expected.reasoning: Metric applies to the full TIA.

Bias Current (Id).description: Current sunk by a single branch (e.g., N3) at nominal bias

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law for SKY130 NMOS at Vbias=0.7V.

Output Resistance (Rout).description: Small-signal output resistance of the current sink

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on channel length modulation parameter lambda=0.1/V.

Current Matching Ratio (N6/N3).description: Ratio of current in branch N6 (2 parallel devices) to branch N3 (1 device)

sky130_expected.calculation: N6 has XM3 and XM4 in parallel, N3 has XM5. Ratio should be exactly 2.

step3_testbench.description: Measures bias currents, current matching ratio, and output resistance of the current sink array.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Current Mirror / Bias Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM1 N2 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Bias voltage
Vbias N7 GND 0.7

* Drain voltages for measuring current
Vd2 N2 GND 1.8
Vd3 N3 GND 1.8
Vd5 N5 GND 1.8
Vd6 N6 GND 1.8

.control
op
let id2 = -i(Vd2)
let id3 = -i(Vd3)
let id5 = -i(Vd5)
let id6 = -i(Vd6)
let ratio_6_3 = id6 / id3

print id2 id3 id5 id6
print ratio_6_3

* DC sweep to find Rout of branch N3
dc Vd3 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc id3_1 find i(Vd3) at=0.9
meas dc id3_2 find i(Vd3) at=1.8
let rout3 = (1.8 - 0.9) / -(id3_2 - id3_1)
print rout3

quit
.endc
